propositions: check_server_manifest.py validates only environment variable names but should also validate description and isRequired fields
server.json may contain duplicate environment variable names that current validation does not detect
MCP_ENV_VARS is the canonical source for environment variable names and descriptions; server.json records must match normalized versions
isRequired field must always be false in manifest records; any record with true causes validation failure
description mismatches between MCP_ENV_VARS and server.json must be detected and reported with field-level detail
